name: Prune old memory entries
summary: The user removes stale memory entries in one command, to keep the listing short.
context: Typed memory grows with every session and old entries crowd the listing.

vocabulary.definition: the date before which an entry is stale

useCases.name: Prune old memory entries
useCases.intent: remove the entries saved before a cut-off
useCases.where: the memory command, beside its listing
scenario: the entries older than it leave the store

rules.name: A feedback entry stays
rules.statement: a feedback entry stays whatever its age

questions.question: Does a prune with no cut-off refuse?
